\section{Projects}
\resumeItemListStart
      \resumeItem{\textbf{Rubik's Cube Solving Robot} \textit{(Nov 2024)}: Built a robot that solves a cube in under three seconds using camera-based perception, Kociemba's planning algorithm, and custom stepper-motor hardware.}

      \resumeItem{\textbf{Interpretable Reinforcement Learning} \textit{(Dec 2019)}: Distilled black-box policies into readable decision sets using DAgger and quantified the interpretability-performance tradeoff in an HIV treatment simulator.}
